Handed to the team · Empty-box claim on a delivered parcel: carrier claim and replacement decision ar

Hi Mike,

I'm sorry, that's not what should have turned up at your door. I can see the parcel for shipment ···· was marked delivered on October 21, and you opened it to find packing paper and a label, no miner. I've put the full details on your order and asked a colleague to call you on (phone hidden). The team is offline right now and picks this up tomorrow from 10am ET, and you'll get the answer by email too if a call doesn't catch you.

One thing that will speed it up a lot: please keep the box, the paper and the label exactly as they are, and take a few photos of the outside of the box, the reseal and the contents. That's what the carrier and our warehouse need to settle it quickly.

On the item itself, your order was changed on October 9 and the NerdOctaxe line was replaced by the Hammer Miner Thor P2, with a small 68 cent difference refunded at the time, so the Thor P2 label is the right one for that order. It's the unit that's missing from the box, and that's what we'll be putting right.

On your newer order, Shop····: the three Hammer DC06 units left our Tennessee warehouse on October 21 in one parcel, tracking ····, (tracking link hidden) , due to you on October 23. The O. add-on from the September order was delivered on October 16.

Sorry again for the trouble, Mike. We'll get this sorted.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

why was it replaced in the first place? i included some pictures and have
saved everything. the box also looks like it got wet.

Hi Mike,

Thanks for the photos and for keeping everything, that helps a lot. I've added them and the water damage you're describing to your file, and both go in front of the colleague picking this up tomorrow from 10am ET, along with your number for the call.

On your question, here is what the record shows. The NerdOctaxe was on backorder with no firm date, and on October 9 the line on order Shop···· was changed to a Hammer Miner Thor P2, with the 68 cent price difference refunded to your PayPal the same day. The order edited and refund notices went to the email address that sits on that order, which is not this one, so it makes complete sense that the first you saw of a Thor P2 was the label in the box. What I can't tell you from here is exactly what was agreed with you before that change was made, and I'm not going to guess at it. The colleague calling you will go through that with you.

Nothing is settled yet on the parcel itself, and nothing is being held against you. You received an empty, resealed, water damaged box, and that gets put right one way or another, whether that is the Thor P2 or a different unit if you would rather not have that model.

Your other order, Shop···· with the three Hammer DC06 units, is on the road and due October 23 on tracking ····, so that one is unaffected.

Sorry again, Mike. We'll have this moving in the morning.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Mike,

You're welcome. Nothing more is needed from you tonight, just hold on to the box and the packing until someone has spoken with you.

A colleague has your number and picks this up tomorrow from 10am ET, and you'll get it in writing here as well. Your three DC06 units are still due on October 23 on tracking ····.

Thanks for your patience with this one, Mike.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
